# Aster — Gateway
## Decision
API gateway проверяет client certificate на входе и передаёт verified identity сервису.
Контроль подлинности на границе Aster снимает обязанность повторно проверять client certificate внутри сервиса.
## Control
REQ-AST-101: запрещён обход gateway напрямую из пользовательского сегмента.
## Target
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mTLS | 15 минут | rotation overlap |

domain: aster

The rejected alternative is not an approved architecture decision.

# Birch — Event bus
## Constraints
REQ-BIR-102: consumer дедуплицирует eventId до изменения состояния.
## Decision
События заказа публикуются через transactional outbox после фиксации бизнес-транзакции.
Outbox Birch позволяет повторить публикацию уже зафиксированного заказа после сбоя publisher.
## Measurement
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| outbox | 7 суток | retention |

# Cobalt — Object storage
## Operational target
| Metric | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cold tier | 45 дней | transition age |
## Decision
Объекты Cobalt размещаются по политике класса хранения, а внешние ключи остаются стабильными.
Смена storage class в Cobalt является внутренней операцией и не меняет идентификатор объекта для клиента.
## Mandatory rule
REQ-COB-103: delete marker не удаляет предыдущую версию до окончания retention.

Access token выпускается для конкретной audience; downstream не принимает токен другого сервиса.

| access token | 8 минут | TTL |

# Fjord — Archive
## Constraints

---
status: accepted
domain: atlas
---
# Atlas — Service contract
The Atlas API gateway validates request size before service dispatch.
Each API route has a versioned contract and an independent rate limit.
Gateway service errors use a stable correlationId; response payloads are not logged.
An API consumer migrates to a new major version before removal of old routes.

---
status: accepted
domain: basil
---
# Basil — Source registry
Basil stores a content digest and source version for each external registration.
An API service resolves the source locator only after authorization.
The registry publishes a new version after verifying source bytes.
Audit events record source identity, not document payload.

---
status: accepted
domain: cedar
---
# Cedar — Certificate lifecycle
Cedar rotates service certificates using a two-phase deployment.
The API gateway verifies the service certificate chain and TLS hostname.
Certificate rotation does not change the service identity in the access registry.
Expired credentials trigger typed access failure.

---
status: accepted
domain: dahlia
---
# Dahlia — Replication
Dahlia replicates database state to a read-only secondary region.
The replication service exports version and lag through an API.
Write traffic remains isolated from the secondary until failover approval.
Database backup retention is independent from replication lag.

---
status: accepted
domain: elm
---
# Elm — Message dispatch
Elm publishes domain events to an event bus using separate service credentials.
The eventId is generated before dispatch and preserved during retry.
A consumer writes processing status before acknowledgement.
Queue backlog and retry budget are monitored per consumer.

---
status: accepted
domain: finch
---
# Finch — Object lifecycle
Finch object storage uses separate retention and storage class policies.
An API exposes object versions without revealing storage node addresses.
The deletion service records audit events for expired objects.
Immutable object versions remain accessible according to policy.

---
status: accepted
domain: glacier
---
# Glacier — API governance
Glacier registers each API version with an owner and compatibility status.
A gateway rejects requests for retired API routes.
The service contract describes each response error and retry behavior.
API schema review includes consumer migration impact.

---
status: accepted
domain: hemlock
---
# Hemlock — Access policy
Hemlock evaluates tenant and resource identity before API authorization.
The access token audience is bound to one service.
Gateway access failures are recorded without raw credentials.
The management plane API uses a separate authorization policy.

---
status: accepted
domain: indigo
---
# Indigo — Change control
Indigo stores a change request and approval revision before deployment.
The deployment API exposes service readiness and rollout state.
A rollback decision references the previous version and recovery plan.
The audit service records operator approval and actionId.

---
status: accepted
domain: jasper
---
# Jasper — Evidence registry
Jasper links evidence to a source digest and original locator.
A search API returns source-backed records rather than generated claims.
Source version changes invalidate previously indexed evidence.
The service records ranking diagnostics separately from evidence text.

---
status: accepted
domain: koala
---
# Koala — Storage backup
Koala performs incremental backups of the object metadata database.
A backup service checks source consistency before archival.
Restore readiness is verified before opening API traffic.
Backup retention and recovery target are tracked separately.

---
status: accepted
domain: lotus
---
# Lotus — Policy evaluation
Lotus evaluates access policies against typed tenant Properties.
The policy API rejects unknown classification before document disclosure.
A policy version and source digest are attached to each decision.
The audit service records policy identifiers without credentials.

---
status: accepted
domain: maple
---
# Maple — Async processing
Maple sends work requests through a bounded queue service.
An API client polls a stable operationId for status.
A cancelled operation must not publish a newer source version.
Retry and timeout limits are defined in the service contract.

---
status: accepted
domain: north
---
# North — Observability
North correlates API gateway and service traces by correlationId.
The observability service exposes sampling status through an API.
Trace records omit authentication credentials and raw document text.
Latency measurements include both gateway and downstream service time.

---
status: accepted
domain: opal
---
# Opal — Cache consistency
Opal caches registry results by source version and tenant.
A gateway service validates cache freshness before returning evidence.
Cache invalidation events include sourceId but exclude source payload.
An API outage leaves the last verified source version available for explicit retry.

---
status: accepted
domain: pebble
---
# Pebble — Audit exports
Pebble stores audit events in an append-only data service.
The audit API returns an authorized interval and correlationId filter.
Audit export retention is governed by a separate policy.
The service verifies export digest before delivering the result.

---
status: accepted
domain: reed
---
# Reed — Network controls
Reed isolates administration traffic from the application gateway.
A management API requires authenticated service identity.
Gateway routes enforce tenant and source network restrictions.
Service certificates are rotated independently of API version updates.

---
status: accepted
domain: saffron
---
# Saffron — Schema migration
Saffron validates API schema compatibility before service deployment.
The schema registry assigns a new version to incompatible events.
A consumer contract test exercises the previous and next API versions.
Migration rollback is reviewed with the database service owner.

---
status: accepted
domain: teal
---
# Teal — Tenant quotas
Teal assigns API rate limits separately from storage quotas.
Gateway admission rejects requests that exceed the tenant budget.
The service measures request latency and bounded Retry-After values.
Quota changes are auditable policy revisions.

---
status: accepted
domain: willow
---
# Willow — Document intake
Willow validates original file digests at an ingestion API boundary.
The document service retains source version and verification status.
Derived files use independent identifiers and retention rules.
An API consumer receives the source locator only within its authorized scope.

status: review
domain: aster

# Aster — design review and operational checks
The ingress certificate chain is inspected in the gateway acceptance test.
A rejected service-only TLS design was retained for comparison.
A service mesh certificate is not evidence of the original client identity.
Rotation overlap is observed during ingress certificate change, not session renewal.
Checklist REQ-AST-101: link the accepted requirement in the test plan.
Review finding: REQ-AST-101 is tracked by the architecture board, not defined here.

status: review
domain: birch
---

Publisher restart recovery tests preserve the eventId after commit.
A broker acknowledgement alone does not prove that the order was committed.
The outbox cleanup job is independent of consumer deduplication.
A retry test confirms an already committed transaction can be republished.
Checklist REQ-BIR-102: link the accepted requirement in the test plan.
Review finding: REQ-BIR-102 is tracked by the architecture board, not defined here.

---
status: review
domain: cobalt
---
# Cobalt — design review and operational checks
The storage class migration review checks unchanged object keys.
A lifecycle dry run compares current and historical object versions.
An alternative bucket migration changes external object addresses and is rejected.
A delete marker is visible to version-aware clients; purge is a separate action.
Checklist REQ-COB-103: link the accepted requirement in the test plan.
Review finding: REQ-COB-103 is tracked by the architecture board, not defined here.

status: review
domain: delta
---
# Delta — design review and operational checks
Audience validation tests use an access token issued to a different API.
A refresh operation is not a downstream API access decision.
The identity service logs token type but not token value.
The access token expiry check is independent of signing algorithm.
Checklist REQ-DEL-104: link the accepted requirement in the test plan.
Review finding: REQ-DEL-104 is tracked by the architecture board, not defined here.

---
status: review
domain: ember
---
# Ember — design review and operational checks
Trace samples from separate services are correlated using a propagated trace header.
Log retention and trace sampling are separate operational policies.
A trace export test must not disclose credentials or request payload.
The collector does not change the source application spanId.
Checklist REQ-EMB-105: link the accepted requirement in the test plan.
Review finding: REQ-EMB-105 is tracked by the architecture board, not defined here.

---
status: review
domain: fjord
---
# Fjord — design review and operational checks
An archive checksum test compares the uploaded original with a retrieved original.
PDF rendering creates a derivative; OCR output is not the original file.
